answer: Farming becomes a terrace bet on surviving 46 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the zephyr schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 46 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
